Title: Relates to deadline for the processing of building permits by local governments and the city of New York
Summary: Requires local building departments to process and approve or deny applications for residential or mixed-use buildings within 30 days; provides that if the local department does not process the application within the required timeframe an applicant shall be permitted to retain a private professional to perform the permit review to determine compliance with state and/or local building codes.
LawCode: Amd §381, Exec L; amd §28-105.5, NYC Ad Cd
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the executive law and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to time limitations for application review and issuance of residential and mixed-use building permits
